# Adopt Ruby example

Ruby tree with a `greet` package and a stdlib-only `solo` package.

```sh
bazel run @rules_dx//:dx -- init //ruby/tests/fixtures/adopt-ruby/...
bazel run @rules_dx//:dx -- generate //ruby/tests/fixtures/adopt-ruby/...
bazel build //ruby/tests/fixtures/adopt-ruby/...
bazel test //ruby/tests/fixtures/adopt-ruby/...
```

Both tests pass (`greet_spec`, `solo_test`).
